about_short_description.short_description: True Link is a diversified financial services firm dedicated to providing services for at-risk demographics such as the elderly and disabled

product.name: True Link Visa® Prepaid Card
product.description: A prepaid Visa card with administrator-controlled spending rules, fund transfers, transaction monitoring, and real-time alerts for people who need supported financial independence.

product.name: Investment Management and Trust Administration
product.description: Investment management and related trust administration services for trusts, conservatorships, pooled trusts, and their beneficiaries, provided by True Link Financial Advisors, LLC.

product.name: Family Banking Solutions
product.description: Banking technology and operational services that help banks and credit unions offer caregiver, family, youth, and supported-spending accounts with configurable controls and monitoring.

product.name: Ledger
product.description: A reconciliation and accounting platform for representative payees and other professionals who manage finances for multiple clients.

product.name: Retina™ AI Fraud Prevention
product.description: An AI-based fraud prevention service for financial institutions that analyzes merchant and transaction data to identify and block suspected scams before a card charge is completed.
